invariants.statement: Temporal progress requires an atomic no-clobber completion protocol.
mandatory_consequences: At most one successor claim may complete for a committed temporal head.
A failed projection attempt does not advance the committed sequence.
Every committed sequence has exactly one complete projection bundle.
Every failed claimed attempt produces a ClockProjectionFailure receipt.
No consumer may observe a new sequence before mandatory projections and quarantine effects commit.

invariants.statement: Every primary/shadow graph difference requires full replay until irrelevance is mechanically certified.
mandatory_consequences: Added, removed, relabeled, rescoped, temporal, authority, and evidence-admission differences trigger full replay.
No cut-set or dependency-cone optimization is trusted without a mechanically verified relevance certificate.
The default replay policy is FULL_REPLAY.

invariants.statement: Release compilation is event-triggered after a completed snapshot and is not part of every clock tick.
mandatory_consequences: Release compilation is absent from the mandatory clock projection phase order.
Release and promotion requests pin a completed snapshot and quarantine epoch.
Promotion creates a new release identity and manifest.

invariants.statement: Reducers consume only committed ValidatedEvent receipts.
mandatory_consequences: Raw and rejected events cannot enter reducers.
Signature and validation-policy interpretation occurs before reduction.
Historical validation is bound to the original policy digest and committed context tick.

invariants.statement: Disposition may govern operational use but may not establish or replace a substantive CSD verdict.
Reality Assurance may expose ignorance, evidence absence, expiry, challenge, disagreement, or required action, but may not assert external truth or world-model completeness.

change_rule: Changing an invariant statement or mandatory consequence requires a new registry version and an explicit migration review.
